intro.title: Grimoire of Kindred Paths
intro.description: Every thread of blood that leads back to me, bound into this grimoire: fellow hunters, workshops of practice, hunting grounds and summons of direct invocation.
section.network.title: Allied Hunters
section.network.description: The lanterns where word is passed — to speak, to hunt together, to follow the trail of my daily craft.
section.craft.title: Where Blades are Whet
section.craft.description: Where I whet my trick weapons — code katas, front-end trials and the offensive arts of the night.
section.arena.title: Quiet Hunting Grounds
section.arena.description: A few gentle hunts, to keep the eye keen between the great hunts.
section.summon.title: Direct Invocation
section.summon.description: The swiftest bells to toll, should you wish to call upon me for a hunt shared.
outro: May the good blood guide your way. Until the next awakening.
